extraction_strategy.execution_mode: codeql query run + codeql bqrs decode --format=csv (multi-column candidate tables; no @kind problem/table metadata, no database analyze/SARIF)
extraction_strategy.sink_modeling_target: SQL query text (or SQL-syntax-affecting fragment) passed as argument 0 of DB-API execute-family calls (cursor.execute, cursor.executemany, connection.execute, executescript) plus SQLAlchemy text()/engine.execute; string concatenation and SQL object construction are recorded via the arg-0 snippet and the sqlalchemy text() intermediate family, and must be traced to a real execute call during labeling
